en.headline: 414 own commits and 706 automated ones across nine repos, plus issue work
en.teaser: Most of the window went into OpenCode tooling: a skill manager, an agent sandbox, a translation extension and a model picker. Upstream, issue reports went to OpenChamber and OpenCode.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-07 to 2026-11-05 with no missing days. Across all repositories there were 414 own commits plus 706 automated commits, 43 issue actions and no pull requests or reviews.

### OpenCode tooling

The largest share of work went into `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, where the daily-report pipeline gained Discussions collection and display, and the documentation was reworked with flow diagrams covering push-to-main, Cloudflare Workers Builds and the watchdog, plus a new ops index and a branch-first rule in AGENTS.md. `opencode-skill-management` built the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, then shipped 0.1.0-rc.0, 0.1.0-rc.1, 0.2.0, 1.0.0, 1.1.0 and 1.2.0; 1.1.0 switched all four actions to a single JSON object with a declared output schema, and 1.2.0 fixed the diverged-skill count and frontmatter boolean parsing. `opencode-agent-sandbox` was started and filled with a knowledge base covering OpenCode V2 distribution, authentication, Windows path issues and remote branch deletion risks.

### Other own projects

`sopen-translate` grew from an MV3 skeleton into a page-translation extension with bilingual rendering, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker, a provider protocol layer with presets and a glossary pipeline, plus JSDoc type checking and DOM smoke tests. `pixel-logo-toolkit` added automatic text wrapping and overflow protection, a bilingual CLI, a 40-image command gallery and a Korean font fix, releasing v0.2.0 and v0.3.0. `opencode-go-model-picker` reworked its scripts for atomic snapshot writes and proxy support, extended agent discovery, and released v1.4.0, 2.0.0, 3.0.0 and 3.0.1, the last cutting the skill text by roughly 92 percent. `meld-deepresearch` added a thin `meld.py` CLI and released v0.4.0. `asset-inventory` corrected skill invocation facts across docs and samples and released v1.15.4 and v1.15.5. `myBlog` only received OpenChamber capture screenshots.

### Upstream issue work

Most issue actions were upstream reports: 23 in `openchamber/openchamber` covering storage management, MCP settings, session retention hints, quote-card navigation, file-view commenting, context panel math, capture resolution and model switching, along with several Ideas discussions. 12 issue actions went to `anomalyco/opencode`, mainly around MiMo vision handling on the Go endpoint, subagent model errors and Windows CLI access. Two issue actions went to `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim` about session discovery on OpenCode V2.

highlights.text: v1.0.0 froze the skill_management surface for 1.x after the 0.1.0 release candidates.
3.0.0 cut the skill text from 104,181 to 8,291 characters, about 12.6 times smaller.
v0.3.0 added automatic line wrapping and proportional font-size overflow protection.
v0.4.0 introduced the meld.py thin CLI wrapping all six gate scripts.
Opened a bug report that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Reported that mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input while the Go endpoint rejects images.
Reported that reflect --sessions queries legacy V1 tables and returns 0 sessions on OpenCode V2.
Started an Ideas discussion proposing commenting on selected code rather than only line numbers.

byRepo.text: 130 own commits plus 706 automated commits, 6 issue actions, no PRs, reviews or releases. Work centred on the daily-report pipeline, which gained Discussions collection and display, and on documentation: new flow diagrams for push-to-main, Cloudflare Workers Builds and the watchdog, an ops index, and an AGENTS.md rule requiring code changes to go through branches.

77 own commits, no automated commits, no PRs, issues or reviews, and 4 releases. The `skill_management` plugin was implemented with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, its spec revised, line endings normalised to LF, and releases 0.1.0-rc.0, 0.1.0-rc.1, 0.2.0, 1.0.0, 1.1.0 and 1.2.0 published; 1.1.0 moved all actions to a JSON envelope with an output schema.

80 own commits, no automated commits, no PRs, issues, reviews or releases. The repository was initialised and filled with a knowledge base on OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture and authentication, Windows path pitfalls, oh-my-opencode-slim findings, remote branch deletion checks and Excalidraw sketches, with AGENTS.md added and the knowledge scope generalised.

56 own commits, no automated commits, no PRs, issues, reviews or releases. The extension went from an MV3 skeleton to page-only translation with bilingual rendering, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker, progress reporting, a provider protocol layer with presets and a glossary pipeline, plus JSDoc checkJs typing, DOM smoke tests, state reset between runs and required-field validation.

29 own commits, no automated commits, no PRs, issues or reviews, and 2 releases. Added automatic text wrapping with overflow protection, a bilingual CLI, an English-first README split, a 40-image command gallery, a Korean font fix using Galmuri, right-side decoration width handling and a Pillow-free query path; v0.2.0 and v0.3.0 were published.

25 own commits, no automated commits, no PRs, issues or reviews, and 4 releases. Scripts gained atomic snapshot writes, proxy-aware re-runs, version-badge drift checks and fuller agent discovery output, and the price seed expiry and 2.0.0 layout were finished; v1.4.0, 2.0.0, 3.0.0 and 3.0.1 shipped, with 3.0.0 shrinking the skill text by about 92 percent.

No commits, PRs, reviews or releases; 23 issue actions. Reports covered storage management, the missing Console MCP server in settings, the stale session retention hint, the quote-card arrow, file-view line-number commenting, the context panel breakdown bar, 1x browser captures, unlinking agent-linked issues, skipped-role merging and model switching defaults, alongside several Ideas discussions on extensions, session stats and encrypted relay keys.

No commits, PRs, reviews or releases; 12 issue actions. Reports and follow-ups concerned MiMo-V2.6-Flash vision reading stale images, subagents failing with model_coming_soon, the Go endpoint rejecting images that models advertise, Windows desktop lacking a way to run the bundled CLI, worktree removal blocked by cached locations, and auth.json removal not clearing the model list.

7 own commits, no automated commits, no PRs, issues or reviews, and 1 release. Added a bilingual Excalidraw sketch of the run flow, split it into English and Chinese scenes, restructured both READMEs to the Standard Readme spec, added the `meld.py` thin CLI, lightened the skill with a --fix option and two gate downgrades, and published v0.4.0.

6 own commits, no automated commits, no PRs, issues or reviews, and no releases. Corrected skill invocation facts across the skill, rule, samples, quick-start fences and guides, removed stale /asset-inventory slash-command references, fixed Japanese localisation, and cut v1.15.4 and v1.15.5.

4 own commits, no automated commits, no PRs, issues, reviews or releases. Only OpenChamber capture samples were added: desktop-1440x900.jpg, panel-region-1to1.png, mobile-390x844.jpg and a session retention hint screenshot.

No commits, PRs, reviews or releases; 2 issue actions. Opened a bug report that reflect --sessions session discovery queries legacy V1 tables and returns 0 sessions on OpenCode V2, then followed up on it.

zh.headline: 本人提交 414 次、自动提交 706 次，另向上游提交大量 issue
zh.teaser: 这段时间主要投入 OpenCode 周边工具：技能管理器、Agent 沙箱、翻译扩展和模型选择器。上游方面向 OpenChamber 与 OpenCode 提交了问题报告。
zh.overview:
统计窗口为 2026-10-07 至 2026-11-05，没有缺失日期。全部仓库合计本人提交 414 次，另有自动提交 706 次，issue 互动 43 次，没有 PR 和评审。

### OpenCode 周边工具

投入最多的是 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`：日报流水线新增 Discussions 采集与展示，文档重画了推送 main、Cloudflare Workers Builds 和 watchdog 的流程图，新增 ops 索引，并在 AGENTS.md 中加入代码修改必须走分支的约束。`opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，随后发布 0.1.0-rc.0、0.1.0-rc.1、0.2.0、1.0.0、1.1.0 和 1.2.0；1.1.0 把四个动作统一改为带输出 schema 的单个 JSON 对象，1.2.0 修正了技能差异计数和 frontmatter 布尔值解析。`opencode-agent-sandbox` 从初始提交起步，沉淀了 OpenCode V2 分发、认证、Windows 路径坑和远程分支删除风险等知识。

### 其他自有项目

`sopen-translate` 从 MV3 骨架发展为只保留整页翻译的扩展，具备双语渲染、分块、熔断、进度、provider 协议层与术语表流水线，并补上 JSDoc 类型检查和 DOM 冒烟测试。`pixel-logo-toolkit` 增加文本自动折行与溢出保护、中英双语命令行、40 张示例画廊和韩语字体修正，发布 v0.2.0 与 v0.3.0。`opencode-go-model-picker` 重写了脚本的快照原子写入与代理支持，扩展了 Agent 发现，发布 v1.4.0、2.0.0、3.0.0 和 3.0.1，其中 3.0.0 把技能文本压缩约 92%。`meld-deepresearch` 新增 `meld.py` 精简命令行并发布 v0.4.0。`asset-inventory` 修正了技能调用方式相关表述并发布 v1.15.4、v1.15.5。`myBlog` 只新增了 OpenChamber 截图。

### 上游 issue 工作

issue 互动大多发生在上游：`openchamber/openchamber` 有 23 次，涉及存储管理、MCP 设置、会话保留提示、引用卡片跳转、文件视图评论、上下文面板计算、截图分辨率和模型切换，并新建了若干 Ideas 讨论。`anomalyco/opencode` 有 12 次，集中在 Go 端点的 MiMo 图像处理、子代理模型报错和 Windows 命令行入口。`alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim` 有 2 次，关于 OpenCode V2 下的会话发现。

highlights.text: v1.0.0 在 0.1.0 系列候选版之后把 skill_management 的接口冻结为 1.x。
3.0.0 把技能文本从 104,181 字符压到 8,291 字符，约缩小 12.6 倍。
v0.3.0 增加文本自动折行，并在溢出时按比例缩小字号。
v0.4.0 引入 meld.py 精简命令行，统一封装六个闸门脚本。
提交缺陷报告：设置中的 MCP 页面缺少 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
报告 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 声明支持图像输入，但 Go 端点拒绝所有图片。
报告 reflect --sessions 查询旧版 V1 数据表，在 OpenCode V2 上返回 0 个会话。
发起 Ideas 讨论，建议支持对选中代码评论，而不只是对行号评论。
